claims.text: November injection barrels start trading October 1, eight days out. The forward balance for November is +191 kb/d into storage; October was the heavy maintenance month at 164 kb/d offline.
Basis signal is bearish: October preliminary -16.48 vs September final -15.32, a 1.16 widening. November basis is unobservable (no strips supplied); nothing fabricated.
The April-2027 tank-top scare is withdrawn. The rebuilt balance has storage roughly flat from 58.7 Mbbl toward ~45.1 Mbbl by Sep 2027; utilization is not computable on the stale provisional capacity.
Enbridge apportionment 12.4% (June 2026, latest CER) keeps the egress flag on WATCH. PADD 2 refinery runs are normal at +307 kb/d vs seasonal norm.
Data calendar: August ST3 actuals due soon (closes the two-month anchor gap); Q3 earnings in late October refresh the maintenance picture.
